A skill earns its place here when it needs **the repository**, needs **the user**,
or needs **a sequence**. Looking a fact up is none of those, which is why the
eleven skills that wrapped a single lookup were removed: the
[MCP tools](https://mcp.vulnetix.com/mcp) and the CLI's own subcommands already
answered those, and three descriptions competing for one question is worse than
one.

| Skill | The one question | Grants |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`container-scan`](container-scan/) | Dockerfile / Containerfile / compose analysis plus optional Trivy / Grype / Syft composition when those binaries are present. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Bash(syft:*) Bash(grype:*) Bash(trivy:*)` |
| [`dashboard`](dashboard/) | Show what this repository has already decided about its vulnerabilities, read from the durable record rather than by scanning again — open versus resolved, the decision taken on each, and what is still waiting. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`dep-resolve`](dep-resolve/) | Dependency-conflict resolution when a `fix` version bump fails — diagnose the peer-dep tree, find a compatible safe version set, propose package-manager overrides (`overrides`/`resolutions`/`replace`/`[patch]`), fall back to safe-harbour inline patching. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Edit Bash(npm:*) Bash(yarn:*) Bash(pnpm:*) Bash(pip:*) Bash(cargo:*) Bash(go:*)` |
| [`dependency-choice`](dependency-choice/) | Work through which package to add for a capability, and what each option costs — maintenance, licence, bundle weight, transitive risk, and whether the platform already does it. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`detection-rules`](detection-rules/) | IDS/IPS detection content for a CVE — Snort/Suricata-compatible rules, YARA signatures, ProjectDiscovery Nuclei templates, traffic-filter rules. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Write` |
| [`eol-check`](eol-check/) | End-of-life detection for runtimes (Node, Python, Java, Go, .NET) and key packages — surfaces past-EOL items, items reaching EOL within 90 days, and EOL base images for containers. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`exploit-test`](exploit-test/) | Generate a runnable exploit-validation command (Nuclei template, Metasploit module hint, AI-assisted Python script, or curl-based PoC) against a user-specified authorised target. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Bash(nuclei:*)` |
| [`fix`](fix/) | Concrete remediation proposal with Safe Harbour confidence — version bump, inline as first-party code, patch, workaround, or advisory. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Edit` |
| [`iac-scan`](iac-scan/) | Terraform / OpenTofu / Nix / k8s manifest misconfiguration detection — open security groups, missing encryption, public S3/GCS, IAM wildcards, plaintext secrets, missing tags. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`license-check`](license-check/) | Package license analysis — detect copyleft conflicts against a permissive policy, surface AGPL / SSPL / GPL contaminants, output SPDX SBOM with per-package license findings. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`repo-impact`](repo-impact/) | Answer whether a specific advisory reaches anything in THIS repository — which manifest declares the package, at what version, whether the version is in range, and whether the vulnerable code is reachable. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`sast-scan`](sast-scan/) | Static application security testing (SAST) for changed source files — Vulnetix's built-in rule set plus optional Semgrep augmentation when `.semgrep` config is present. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Bash(semgrep:*)` |
| [`sbom-generate`](sbom-generate/) | Generate CycloneDX 1.7 and/or SPDX 2.3 SBOMs for the repo, optionally cosign-signed, optionally cross-validated against syft output. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Write Bash(syft:*) Bash(cosign:*)` |
| [`secret-scan`](secret-scan/) | Hardcoded-secret detection — AWS keys, GitHub PATs, Slack tokens, Stripe keys, generic high-entropy strings. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`secure-code-write`](secure-code-write/) | Proactive secure-coding coach scoped to the file or topic you are working on — surfaces relevant SAST rule IDs, CWE patterns, language-specific PASS/FAIL code snippets. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`typosquat-check`](typosquat-check/) | Typosquat and malicious-package detection across installed dependencies (or a single prospective addition) — cross-checks AI-malware family intelligence, package-name similarity to known popular packages, low maintainer-health signals. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob` |
| [`verify-fix`](verify-fix/) | Post-fix verification — re-scan the repo, gate on `--exploits weaponized --severity high`, recheck the specific CVE against the new installed version, write the verdict to `.vulnetix/memory.yaml`. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Bash(git:*)` |
| [`vex-publish`](vex-publish/) | Generate OpenVEX / CycloneDX VEX attestations from `.vulnetix/memory.yaml` triage decisions, optionally sign with cosign, optionally upload to Vulnetix and post to a GitHub PR. | `Bash(vulnetix:*) Read Grep Glob Write Bash(cosign:*) Bash(gh:*)` |

`allowed-tools` is scoped to what each body actually runs. No skill gets bare
`Bash`; no read-only skill gets `Write`.
